note: Fifteen 5-star reviews picked from the 190 Google loaded in a browser on 2026-10-24 (about 11% of those 190 were 1-star). Each card is a short summary written by us, not a quote. Reviewers are shown as first name and last initial, with initials instead of photos. Loan officers' names, rates, timelines and reverse-mortgage reviews are left out. Google shows only relative dates.

items.name: Donnell C.
items.summary: The customer said their loan officer laid out plenty of options for a cash-out refinance so they could decide, and stayed responsive throughout.
